svg.text: Fig. R3 — The bench test: B_r round the ring, 3 mm outside, in the mid-plane
a Hall probe carried round the ring (or the ring turned under it); sign changes count the poles
angle round the ring (section joints every 30°)
Twelve sign changes for both alternating rings, peaks shifted by half a section (15°): radial poles sit mid-section, along-the-ring poles at the joints.
